name: Business-Airport Shimbashi
card: Full of motifs recalling the birthplace of Japan's railways
title: Business-Airport Shimbashi — a workplace full of motifs from Shimbashi, birthplace of the railway, on floors 6–8 of Shimbashi Place
lead: Business-Airport Shimbashi, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 6th to 8th floors of Shimbashi Place in Shimbashi 1-chome. Shimbashi, birthplace of Japan's railways, has always led the times, and the website describes a workplace full of motifs that recall the district. There are four meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00, Saturdays 10:00–18:00 / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: Leading the times from the birthplace of the railway
The website writes: “Shimbashi, birthplace of the railway, has always been ahead of its time. Business-Airport Shimbashi is full of motifs that evoke the district.”
A brand named after an airport brings the memory of a railway town into its interior. As places of departure, the two overlap.
steps: From 7:00 on weekdays, and open on Saturdays
Coworking is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and 10:00–18:00 on Saturdays.
Address membership is ¥71,500 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
Private ROOMs start at ¥184,800 a month and BOOTHs at ¥136,400.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
The meeting rooms are 7A (8 people, ¥3,300/hour), 7B (6 people, ¥2,750/hour), 6A (4 people, ¥2,200/hour) and 8A (8 people, ¥3,300/hour).
Spread across three floors, the site lets you choose a room by the size of your meeting.

word.title: Why is Shimbashi the birthplace of the railway?
body: Shimbashi was the site of Japan's first railway station. Business-Airport Shimbashi brings motifs evoking that history into its interior.
When a district's history becomes the starting point for an interior, the result is a space that could only exist in that place.

name: Business-Airport Tamachi
card: Calm and function, in the tradition of the distinguished office
title: Business-Airport Tamachi — a workplace carrying on the dignified office tradition, on the 2nd floor of Tamachi Square
lead: Business-Airport Tamachi, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 2nd floor of Tamachi Square in Shiba 5-chome. It holds that the joy of working with a sense of fulfilment opens up the future, and aims for a workplace where calm and function coexist, carrying on the dignified office that has long symbolised business status. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: ROOM (single and multi-person) / coworking / meeting rooms A, B / online meeting room
concept: Carrying on the dignified office

The website describes Business-Airport Tamachi, in the heart of the city, as a workplace that inherits the form of the dignified office that has symbolised business status, where calm and functionality coexist — because the joy of working with fulfilment opens the future.
Rather than chasing the new, it carries on a respected tradition. It is a base for people who value calm.
steps: Address membership is ¥71,500 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
A single ROOM for ¥132,000 a month
A single-person ROOM costs ¥132,000 a month; multi-person ROOMs start at ¥308,000.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
Meeting room A seats six at ¥2,750 an hour; room B seats eight at ¥3,300.
The one-person online meeting room costs ¥550 per 30 minutes.

word.title: What does a “dignified” office mean?
body: The Japanese word kakushiki refers to established forms and manners befitting one's standing. Business-Airport Tamachi says it carries on the form of the dignified office.
Choosing forms long valued over the latest novelty — a choice for people who seek calm.

name: Business-Airport Shinagawa
card: 28th floor of Taiyo Life Shinagawa Building — business success starts in Shinagawa
title: Business-Airport Shinagawa — a high-rise workplace on the 28th floor of the Taiyo Life Shinagawa Building
lead: Business-Airport Shinagawa, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 28th floor of the Taiyo Life Shinagawa Building in Konan 2-chome. Its slogan: “Business success starts in Shinagawa.” It is a high-rise base with a workspace that combines design and function. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: ROOM (1–6 people) / DESK / coworking / meeting rooms A, B, C / online meeting room
Coworking weekdays 8:00–20:00 (closed weekends and holidays) / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: Business success starts in Shinagawa
Business-Airport Shinagawa's slogan is “Business success starts in Shinagawa.” It is on the 28th floor of the Taiyo Life Shinagawa Building in Konan 2-chome.
Business-Airport is Tokyu Land's brand, named after an airport where diverse people gather and depart — and here you take off from high above Shinagawa.
steps: Coworking is open 8:00–20:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and closed on weekends and holidays.
Address membership is ¥82,500 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
ROOMs for 1–6 people cost ¥165,000 a month; a single DESK is ¥126,500.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
One room for eight, two for four
Meeting room A seats eight at ¥3,300 an hour; rooms B and C seat four at ¥2,200.
The one-person online meeting room costs ¥550 per 30 minutes.

word.title: Why work on a high floor?
body: Business-Airport Shinagawa is on the 28th floor of the Taiyo Life Shinagawa Building.
Higher floors open up the view from the windows and take you away from the noise of the street.

name: Business-Airport Ebisu
card: Ebisu expressed in soft curves — a space like your own base
title: Business-Airport Ebisu — a workplace expressing Ebisu in soft curves, on the 2nd and 10th floors of Ebisu Business Tower
lead: Business-Airport Ebisu, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 2nd and 10th floors of Ebisu Business Tower in Ebisu 1-chome. The space expresses Ebisu — where many kinds of business cross paths — in soft curves. From a place that feels like your own private base, free thinking beyond boundaries is born, the website says. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: ROOM (single and multi-person) / coworking / meeting rooms A, B, C
Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00, Saturdays 10:00–18:00 / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: Ebisu, expressed in soft curves

The website says it expressed Ebisu, a district where many businesses intersect, in soft curves. From a space like your own private base, free ideas beyond boundaries emerge and help businesses take off.
Creating curved spaces inside a building full of straight lines: at Ebisu, the shape itself is the theme of the design.
steps: From 7:00 on weekdays, and open on Saturdays
Coworking is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays and 10:00–18:00 on Saturdays.
Address membership is ¥82,500 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
A single ROOM costs ¥176,000 a month; multi-person rooms start at ¥308,000.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
Two rooms for six and one for eight
Meeting rooms A and B seat six at ¥2,750 an hour; room C seats eight at ¥3,300.

word.title: Why curves?
body: Design that shapes spaces and furniture with smooth curves rather than angular straight lines. Business-Airport Ebisu expresses its neighbourhood this way.
Curves guide people's movement naturally and soften the hardness of a space.

name: Business-Airport Shinjuku 3-chome
card: A space expressing the diversity of people on Shinjuku's streets
title: Business-Airport Shinjuku 3-chome — a workplace expressing the city's diversity, on floors 4–6 of Q Plaza Shinjuku 3-chome
lead: Business-Airport Shinjuku 3-chome, run by Tokyu Land, is on the 4th to 6th floors of Q Plaza Shinjuku 3-chome. From Shinjuku 3-chome, where all kinds of energy intersect, to the next stage: the website describes a space that expresses the diversity of the people on its streets and generates inspiration and creativity. There are four meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: ROOM / DESK / shared workspace / meeting rooms A–D / online meeting room
Coworking weekdays 7:00–22:00, Saturdays 10:00–18:00 (closed Sundays and holidays) / serviced offices 24 hours
concept: From Shinjuku 3-chome, where every kind of energy meets

The website writes: “From Shinjuku 3-chome, where diverse energies intersect, to the next stage. Shinjuku embraces every kind of diversity and radiates enormous energy. Business-Airport Shinjuku 3-chome offers a space that expresses the diversity of the people on its streets and creates inspiration and creativity.”
It uses three floors of Q Plaza Shinjuku 3-chome, a commercial building in the district.
steps: From 7:00 on weekdays, and open on Saturdays
The shared workspace is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays (reception 9:00–18:00) and 10:00–18:00 on Saturdays.
Address membership is ¥71,500 a month, Master ¥38,500, Private ¥14,300, and Flex ¥550 per 30 minutes.
Private ROOMs start at ¥165,000 a month and fixed DESKs at ¥104,500.
Serviced offices can be entered 24 hours a day.
One room for eight and three for six
Meeting room A seats eight at ¥3,300 an hour; rooms B to D seat six at ¥2,750.
The one-person online meeting room costs ¥550 per 30 minutes.

word.title: Why diversity?
body: People and things of many differences existing together. Business-Airport Shinjuku 3-chome makes the diversity of the people on its streets the theme of its space.
It turns the character of Shinjuku — a city where every kind of person passes through — into the subject of its interior.

name: SENQ Kyobashi
card: Floors 3–4 of Kyobashi Edogrand, themed FOOD INNOVATION
title: SENQ Kyobashi — a “FOOD INNOVATION” workplace on floors 3–4 of Kyobashi Edogrand, directly connected to Kyobashi Station
lead: SENQ Kyobashi is on the 3rd and 4th floors of Kyobashi Edogrand, directly connected to Kyobashi Station on the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line. Its theme is “FOOD INNOVATION”. Around a lounge of about 60 seats are private rooms, booths and meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Lounge (about 60 seats) / rooms / booths / meeting rooms
concept: FOOD INNOVATION
SENQ Kyobashi's theme is “FOOD INNOVATION”. Each SENQ site has its own theme, and Kyobashi focuses on food.
It is on the 3rd and 4th floors of Kyobashi Edogrand, directly connected to exits 7 and 8 of Kyobashi Station, with private rooms, booths and meeting rooms around a lounge of about 60 seats.
steps: A shared space of about 60 seats
The lounge has about 60 seats. Coworking members can use it 9:00–22:00 on weekdays.
Coworking is ¥22,000 a month, and drop-in ¥550 an hour.
Rooms for teams and seats for one
Rooms start at ¥653,400 a month and booths at ¥163,350.
Closed rooms and semi-private seats share the floor with the lounge.
There are meeting rooms for discussions.
Directly connected to Kyobashi Station, it is easy to direct visitors here.

word.title: What is FOOD INNOVATION?
body: Creating new value in the field of food. SENQ Kyobashi takes it as the theme of the site.
When each site has a field as its theme, the conversations among the people who gather tend to line up.

name: SENQ Kasumigaseki
card: A sunken kotatsu table and a dining room, on the 2nd floor in the government district
title: SENQ Kasumigaseki — a “LEAD JAPAN” workplace with a sunken kotatsu, on the 2nd floor of the Nittochi Building
lead: SENQ Kasumigaseki is on the 2nd floor of the Nittochi Building, a one-minute walk from Toranomon Station and three minutes from Kasumigaseki Station. Its theme is “LEAD JAPAN”. It has a lounge for 80, a salon for 40, a dining room, sunken kotatsu seating, 18 rooms and 17 booths. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Lounge (80) / salon (40) / dining / 18 rooms (10.60–39.60 m²) / 17 booths / meeting rooms
concept: LEAD JAPAN
SENQ Kasumigaseki's theme is “LEAD JAPAN”. A one-minute walk from Toranomon Station and three from Kasumigaseki Station, it is easy to reach from government offices, the website says.
True to its name, it has many places for conversation: a lounge, a salon, a dining room and even sunken kotatsu seating.
steps: A lounge for 80 and a salon for 40
The lounge holds 80 people and the salon 40.
Coworking is ¥22,000 a month and drop-in ¥550 an hour, available 9:00–22:00 on weekdays.
A place to eat, and a place to sit and talk
There is a dining room and sunken kotatsu seating.
A sunken kotatsu is rare inside an office building. Take off your shoes and sit down, and the conversation changes from what happens in a meeting room.
There are 18 rooms from 10.60 m² to 39.60 m², from ¥290,400 a month, and 17 booths from ¥96,800 a month.

word.title: What is a sunken kotatsu?
body: A traditional Japanese seating arrangement where the floor is dug out under a low table so you can sit with your legs hanging down. SENQ Kasumigaseki has one.
Neither a chair nor sitting on the floor, it is a relaxed posture for conversation.

name: SENQ Roppongi
card: A sky terrace on the 9th floor of Shin-Roppongi Building, themed CHANGE THE THEORY
title: SENQ Roppongi — a co-creation space breaking conventions through design and technology, on floors 4–9 of the Shin-Roppongi Building
lead: SENQ Roppongi occupies the 4th to 9th floors of the Shin-Roppongi Building. Its theme is “CHANGE THE THEORY”: a place of co-creation that breaks with conventional thinking through design and technology. The 9th floor has about 70 coworking seats, a café corner, a sky terrace and solo desks. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Private rooms (4F: 2 / 5–6F: 4 / 7–8F: 32) / 9F: about 70 coworking seats, 3 meeting rooms, café corner, sky terrace, solo desks
Coworking weekdays 9:00–22:00 / private rooms 24 hours, 365 days
concept: CHANGE THE THEORY
SENQ Roppongi's theme is “CHANGE THE THEORY” — a place of co-creation that breaks conventions through the power of design and technology, the website says.
It uses the 4th to 9th floors of the Shin-Roppongi Building, with reception on the 9th. There are 38 private rooms on floors 4–8, and the coworking area and terrace are on the 9th.
steps: The 9th-floor coworking area has about 70 seats, with reception, a café corner and solo desks on the same floor.
Coworking is ¥22,000 a month, available 9:00–22:00 on weekdays.
A terrace that changes between day and night
The 9th floor has a sky terrace: bright outdoor seats by day, a place to look down on the city lights by night.
You can step straight from the indoor coworking area into the open air.
There are 2 private rooms on the 4th floor, 4 on the 5th–6th and 32 on the 7th–8th, from ¥169,400 a month, available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
The 9th floor has three meeting rooms.
A private room on the 8th floor
A meeting room on the 9th floor

word.title: What is a sky terrace?
body: An outdoor terrace on an upper floor of a building. SENQ Roppongi has one on its 9th floor.
Having a breezy outdoor space just outside where you work makes it easier to switch moods.
